worm.cape.skitter.name: Skitter
worm.cape.skitter.effect: Controls arthropods and receives sensory signals through them.

combines.value: Swarm scouts and distracts; sensory feedback supports tracking and navigation.

counters.value: Heat kills bugs; contact freezing removes them from control.

worm.cape.shadow_stalker.name: Shadow Stalker
worm.cape.shadow_stalker.effect: Become a lightweight, permeable shadow form that can pass through solids and glide.

combines.value: Insects delay transitions; Grue’s darkness slows and destabilizes the form.

counters.value: Electricity, aerosols, insects, and Grue’s darkness disrupt or harm her.

worm.cape.grue.name: Grue
worm.cape.grue.effect: Spreads darkness that blocks sight and dampens sound.

combines.value: Dampens sound and can diminish Taylor’s bug coordination and control.

counters.value: Clockblocker can freeze Grue in time.

worm.cape.tattletale.name: Tattletale
worm.cape.tattletale.effect: Extrapolates information from clues, filling gaps with increasingly speculative inferences.

counters.value: Insufficient clues make readings unreliable or speculative.

worm.cape.bitch.name: Bitch
worm.cape.bitch.effect: Grows and mutates dogs, increasing their size and physical capabilities.

combines.value: Works best with trained, obedient dogs; Rachel introduces new dogs gradually.

counters.value: Cannot fix old health problems; dogs can be seriously injured or killed.

worm.cape.regent.name: Regent
worm.cape.regent.effect: Controls another person’s body through their nervous system, including involuntary movements.

combines.value: Can stalemate Cherish’s emotional interference.

counters.value: Sleep ends control; distance and multiple targets weaken it.

worm.cape.imp.name: Imp
worm.cape.imp.effect: Makes nearby people forget her presence without making her physically invisible.

combines.value: Her power can interrupt Regent’s control of her.

counters.value: Focused attention worsens it; attention can turn it off.

worm.cape.dinah_alcott.name: Dinah Alcott
worm.cape.dinah_alcott.effect: Reports probabilities for queried future events and compares possible scenarios.

counters.value: Limited questions; vague questions and unknown variables make answers fuzzy.

worm.cape.coil.name: Coil
worm.cape.coil.effect: Runs two realities in parallel, then keeps one and erases the other.

counters.value: Only two realities at once; vulnerable at splits.

worm.cape.brandish.name: Brandish
worm.cape.brandish.effect: Transforms into a compact forcefield sphere and manifests energy weapons.

combines.value: Impacts can redirect the spherical form.

worm.cape.glory_girl.name: Glory Girl
worm.cape.glory_girl.effect: Flies, withstands impacts, exerts great strength, and emits an awe-inducing aura.

combines.value: A strong hit can briefly short the forcefield.

counters.value: A strong hit briefly shorts the forcefield.

worm.cape.panacea.name: Panacea
worm.cape.panacea.effect: Heals injuries and modifies living bodies by touch.

combines.value: Interferes with insect control; modified relay bugs extend a controller’s swarm

counters.value: Affected bugs can be swept away and killed, ending feedback.

worm.cape.marquis.name: Marquis
worm.cape.marquis.effect: Reshapes his own and others’ bones into useful forms and manipulates separated bone.

worm.cape.dragon.name: Dragon
worm.cape.dragon.effect: Designs and deploys specialized technological devices, including armored suits, drones, weapons, and containment systems.

worm.cape.armsmaster.name: Armsmaster
worm.cape.armsmaster.effect: Builds compact, integrated specialized technology and weapons.

combines.value: Electrical effects couple through metal flooring; EMP disables forcefields and m

counters.value: Insulating material blocks electrical coupling; EMP disrupts devices.

worm.cape.weld.name: Weld
worm.cape.weld.effect: Absorbs metal into his body and reshapes his metallic body.

counters.value: Sustained electrical heating can bond metal to him; heavy loads impede him.

worm.cape.lung.name: Lung
worm.cape.lung.effect: Escalating threat transforms him into a larger, armored, regenerating, fire-producing combat form.

combines.value: EpiPens could dangerously intensify his power.

counters.value: Fuel exhaustion; overwhelming heat weakens him; exposed eye can be disabled.

worm.cape.jack_slash.name: Jack Slash
worm.cape.jack_slash.effect: The shard exploits openings in interactions with other powered people.

combines.value: Dialogue and opponents’ actions can change the interaction.

counters.value: Changing the interaction may deny openings.

worm.cape.bonesaw.name: Bonesaw
worm.cape.bonesaw.effect: Engineers biological composites, implants, and bodily alterations through specialized surgery.

combines.value: Combines mixed biology with control frames and safety mechanisms.

worm.cape.trickster.name: Trickster
worm.cape.trickster.effect: Swaps visible things’ positions, with mass differences reducing range and speed.

worm.cape.echidna.name: Echidna
worm.cape.echidna.effect: Absorbs living beings and produces physical copies that retain some of their powers.

combines.value: Copies retain some powers; Noelle can draw and amplify energy from Eidolon's orb

worm.cape.sundancer.name: Sundancer
worm.cape.sundancer.effect: Creates and controls a miniature sun that emits heat and light.

combines.value: Can weaken Lung and burn or melt targets and surroundings.

counters.value: Siberian survives its effects untouched.

worm.cape.perdition.name: Perdition
worm.cape.perdition.effect: Resets a selected target to its position and state from a few seconds earlier.

counters.value: An opponent who knows the loop can exploit repeated resets.

worm.cape.ballistic.name: Ballistic
worm.cape.ballistic.effect: Launches touched objects at supersonic speed.

combines.value: Launched objects can break forcefields on impact.

counters.value: Shatterbird’s glass storm counters it.

worm.cape.vista.name: Vista
worm.cape.vista.effect: Warps nearby space, changing distances and folding solid surroundings into altered terrain.

combines.value: Folded routes combined with Silk Road’s corridors accelerate a craft.

counters.value: Living bodies and crowded areas constrain use.

worm.cape.tecton.name: Tecton
worm.cape.tecton.effect: Armor grounds kinetic energy; piledriver gauntlets fracture ground for localized earthquakes and controlled demolition.

combines.value: Suit technology does not gain strength from nearby power boosts.

counters.value: Destroyed suit computers leave him relying on basics and intuition.

worm.cape.garotte.name: Garotte
worm.cape.garotte.effect: Extends tendrils that grip, constrict, and crush people or structures.

counters.value: Reinforced containment suit, restraints, and emergency foam.

worm.cape.number_man.name: Number Man
worm.cape.number_man.effect: Calculates probabilities and economic outcomes from available data.

worm.cape.doctor_mother.name: Doctor Mother
worm.cape.doctor_mother.effect: No active power; only latent potential.

worm.cape.contessa.name: Contessa
worm.cape.contessa.effect: Reveals a stepwise route to a stated goal, including exact actions and future events.

counters.value: Fog and blind spots around those who know how it works.

worm.cape.scion.name: Scion
worm.cape.scion.effect: Fires golden beams that erase structures and uses foresight to evade threats.

combines.value: Adapts to repeated attacks; foresight is blocked by precogs’ direct views.

counters.value: Precogs’ direct views block foresight.

worm.cape.glaistig_uaine.name: Glaistig Uaine
worm.cape.glaistig_uaine.effect: Summons spirits of dead capes to act as agents and use their powers.

combines.value: Can synergize with other powers; how is uncertain.

counters.value: Scion destroys her constructs and projectiles.

worm.cape.parian.name: Parian
worm.cape.parian.effect: Telekinetically controls light materials and animates fabric constructs.

worm.cape.adamant.name: Adamant
worm.cape.adamant.effect: The power’s specific effect is not established by the evidence.

worm.cape.aegis.name: Aegis
worm.cape.aegis.effect: Redundant biology helps him endure and recover from bodily injury.

counters.value: Powerful blasts can scatter him.

worm.cape.agnes_court.name: Agnes Court
worm.cape.agnes_court.effect: Rapidly constructs large fortified settlements and infrastructure.

counters.value: Leviathan demolished much of the construction.

worm.cape.alexandria.name: Alexandria
worm.cape.alexandria.effect: Grants flight, superhuman strength and durability, speed-of-mind, and memory.

counters.value: Drowning and attacks by unusually powerful threats can still harm her.

worm.cape.allfather.name: Allfather
worm.cape.allfather.effect: The evidence does not state what Allfather's power does.

worm.cape.annex.name: Annex
worm.cape.annex.effect: Merges with and reshapes parts of nonliving objects and surfaces.

counters.value: Limited to part of a nonliving object; senses impaired inside material.

worm.cape.arbiter.name: Arbiter
worm.cape.arbiter.effect: Signals threats through relationship distance using colored circles of concern.

worm.device.ascalon.name: Ascalon
worm.device.ascalon.effect: Activation is intended to stop Dragon, with risk to her surviving data.

combines.value: Designed to locate, control, or kill creations; intended to stop Dragon.

worm.cape.ash_beast.name: Ash Beast
worm.cape.ash_beast.effect: Converts energy to matter and back, sustaining an uncontrollable mass of fire and heat.

combines.value: Its heat disrupts ordinary portals; a forcefield-protected connection worked.

counters.value: Scion’s beam kills him.

worm.cape.assault.name: Assault
worm.cape.assault.effect: The evidence does not establish Assault’s power effect.

worm.cape.august_prince.name: August Prince
worm.cape.august_prince.effect: Prevents others from deliberately harming him, but does not prevent restraint.

combines.value: Usher’s attempted immunity transfer does not counter it; a forcefield can pin hi

counters.value: A forcefield can pin him after a teammate distracts him.

worm.cape.bakuda.name: Bakuda
worm.cape.bakuda.effect: Builds advanced bombs with varied effects, including flash-freezing blasts and spatial distortion.

combines.value: Paired blast can flash-freeze another explosion.

worm.device.bakuda_bombs.name: Bakuda bombs

combines.value: Some explosives are believed capable of bypassing the Manton effect.

worm.cape.bambina.name: Bambina

counters.value: Interrupting his speech or incapacitating him stops the assault.

counters.value: Requires charge buildup; distraction can interfere.

worm.cape.biter.name: Biter

worm.cape.blowout.name: Blowout

counters.value: Only people who hear her voice are affected.

worm.cape.circus.name: Circus

worm.cape.clairvoyant.name: Clairvoyant

worm.cape.clockblocker.name: Clockblocker

counters.value: Avoid contact; the freeze eventually expires.

worm.cape.codex.name: Codex
worm.cape.codex.effect: Slowly drains and damages a target’s brain, impairing intelligence and attention.

worm.cape.cozen.name: Cozen

counters.value: A large blast reportedly kills him; exact conditions are unclear.

worm.cape.crusader.name: Crusader

worm.cape.custodian.name: Custodian

worm.cape.dovetail.name: Dovetail
